g.text: One packet, two paths, one total order
VYRN master diagram · spec 00 · draft 0.2 · figures are budgets
one home region (the sun's), one metro
replays cuts with the same binary
BASE n = 4, q = 3 · CHAIN n = 5, q = 4
sent before the fill. A fill
dies and both paths drop it
other homes follow; the book moves every 8 h
handoff = certificate (e, S) + opening auction · no-fill window ≈ one WAN one-way, 35–110 ms
